fields.description: Weekly issue featuring editorials and local commentary on Miami’s civic development and cooperation, prohibition enforcement and the Christianson case involving U.S. apologies to Great Britain, downtown traffic and double-parking concerns, and the rising cost and regulation of milk in Dade County (including discussion of pasteurization and certified milk). Includes Coral Gables commission politics, short humor and gossip columns, entertainment notes, and numerous local advertisements (including telephone service and ice company promotions).
